P8.needed_evidence: Dense INT8 native capacity upper bound at applicable maximum frequency; instruction existence alone is insufficient

B_HBM.needed_evidence: Applicable aggregate read/write capacity upper bound and sharing rules

B_L2.needed_evidence: L2-to-core capacity upper bound and sharing rules

operators.scope: One independent standard dense INT8 GEMM. No sparsity, answer lookup, alternate matrix algorithms or value-dependent fast paths. M query rows; full N=32768 output features under current enable_dsa_cp replicated-weight path.

assumptions: INT8 A and dense W initially in HBM; W absent from all faster/remote caches
BF16 C must be materialized in HBM
No intermediate compression or alternate remote source; scale/offset traffic omitted optimistically
W may already be in cache; A initially HBM and BF16 C materialized HBM
warm_boundary.note: Zero lower bound on weight HBM traffic is an optimistic omission, not a claim that actual traffic is zero.

operators.throughput_upper_expression: M / L (query rows/s, not accepted model tokens/s)

operators.scope: One selected expert processes m_e rows using standard gate/up/down dense products, H=5120,I=2304. Intermediate activation/scale/communication costs optimistically omitted.
operators.subgraph_rule: Keep both GEMMs and true activation semantics; do not sum independent-operator I/O lower bounds. Intermediate results may remain on chip in ideal fused model.
operators.whole_layer_routed_MAC_expression: 35389440 * sum_e(m_e) = 212336640 * T for exactly top_k=6 valid non-dropped assignments/token
operators.whole_layer_routed_weight_traffic: Depends on actual expert union, batch reuse, residency and sharding; unknown. Cannot multiply every expert weight by every token.

framework_selected_work_chain.scope: Standard target forward evaluation domain, top_k=6 plus one shared expert, all40 layers; selected INT8 products only. No response cache, no substituted model, no alternative dense algorithms. Fusion, ideal sharding/balance/overlap are allowed.
framework_selected_work_chain.P8_all_devices_unit: aggregate dense INT8 MAC/s capacity upper bound

relaxations: All decode and draft computation omitted
All traffic, scheduling and dependencies relaxed

stages.proof_condition: In this standard target-evaluation domain, generating 1024 tokens/request needs target evaluation at >=1023 newly generated input positions/request; the last returned token need not be fed back. Speculative parallel verification changes grouping, not these accepted-prefix target positions. If exact target computation may be bypassed, this constraint does not apply.
relaxations: Rejected speculative positions and entire DSpark draft work omitted
All other compute and traffic remain relaxed

not_claimed: Current model graph optimal among all algorithms
A largest operator gap without kernel durations
